title: Transitivity of restriction extension
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $\rho,\eta,\tau$ be coordinate restrictions on $n$ coordinates. If every coordinate fixed by $\rho$ has the same state in $\eta$, and every coordinate fixed by $\eta$ has the same state in $\tau$, then every coordinate fixed by $\rho$ has the same state in $\tau$.
